ns2:section.sectionText: Students in this course will need to register for one lecture and one discussion section, with both having the same starting letter of the section name. Lectures have L as the second character of the name, while discussions have D as the second character. Previous completion of or concurrent enrollment in MATH 241 is required for this course. For Statistics course registration information: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Computer Engineering or Computer Science or Electrical Engineering or Materials Science & Engr or Mechanical Engineering or Statistics or Geology or Integrative Biology or Mathematics or Actuarial Science or Statistics & Computer Science or Math & Computer Science or Aerospace Engineering or Undeclared or Agricultural & Biological Engr or Systems Engineering and Design or Pre-Engineering major(s).
